title: Signal
description: One scam-intent indicator extracted from a single communication by the model service. A Signal describes evidence. It NEVER contains an action, a recommendation, or a decision - only the deterministic policy gate produces those.

signal_type.description: Which of the eight frozen scam-intent labels this is.

value.description: Raw model score before calibration. Useful for debugging; do NOT use this for decisions - use confidence.

confidence.description: CALIBRATED probability that this signal is genuinely present, post Platt scaling. This is the number fusion and the policy gate consume.

source_ref.description: Id of the communication this was extracted from, e.g. comm_771.

evidence_span.description: Character offsets [start, end) into the REDACTED text, locating the phrase that produced this signal. Used by the UI to highlight in place.

redacted_quote.description: At most one short phrase, already redacted, shown to the analyst as justification. Never the full message body.

model_version.description: Which model and weights produced this, e.g. gemma3n-e4b@2026-09-14.
